requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards for legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall maintain a streamlined audit trail for accountability, retaining critical information for performance and compliance.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards.
The system shall provide mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates and energy-efficient processing.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation to ensure access to essential functionalities during outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data for transparency.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage significantly.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations relevant to financial systems.
